If a **Commando subsection** loses its
**NCO**, roll a die. On a roll of 3 or more, another
model within the unit is immediately selected to

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Pathfinders may always start on the table within the owning player’s deployment area.
If you deploy at least one unit of Pathfinders on the table before the first turn starts (i.e. the Pathfinders are not in the first wave
or in reserve), then any friendly paratroopers and glider units in reserve may re-roll failed order tests to come onto the table.

sharedRules.name: Fanatic
sharedRules.description: If there are atleast 2 **models** in a unit with this they ignore **pin modifiers**  when making **moral rolls** and this unit can not be **destroyed** due to having more **pin markers** then its **moral** if it has 2 models. In **close combat** if a unit with this and atleast 2 models **looses** it actually counts as a **draw** and another **close combat starts**.

sharedRules.name: Front Arc

sharedRules.name: HE(X")
sharedRules.description:
Use X” **template** to determine hits but you **roll 1 hit roll** for all units in the template. In addition the weapon gains +X Pen and deal additional pins based on X:
- 1: D2 pins or D3 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 2: D2 pins or D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 3: D3 pins or 2D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 4: D3 pins or 3D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 5: D6 pins or 4D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building

sharedRules.name: Indirect Fire
sharedRules.description: This unit hits on 6s for its first **Fire Order** then in its next **Fire Order** hits on 5,6 and so if it targets the same unit however as soon as this model gets any other **order** besides **Fire Order** or the **target unit** has moved more then **2"** and this **model** is not **hitting** on 2's  this resets.

sharedRules.name: Landing Craft
sharedRules.description: The standard rules for transports apply to landing craft, with the exception that units must begin the game on landing craft and cannot mount onto them unless the landing craft is partially on solid ground.

sharedRules.name: Green
sharedRules.description: The first time this unit suffers a **casulaity** this game it must make a **moral test**

sharedRules.name: Flamethrower (Infantry)
sharedRules.description:
Due to their diffrence in shotting the do not follow the same rools
- Roll the dice to hit but instead each hit is actually D6 hits and no saves are made it moces over to damage instatly.
- They always hit the top of the vehicle
- Instead of only 1 pin the targted unit suffers D3+1 pins
- The **shooting unit** however also suffers 1 **pin**
- The **targeted** unit then must take a **moral test** if it fails an dits **infantry** the unit is destroyed no matter what. **Vehicles** are abadoned instead
- The **shooting unit** then rolls a D6 and on a 2- the **flamethrower** is used up and this model can no longer use it.

sharedRules.name: Advance Order

sharedRules.name: Fire Order
sharedRules.description: This model can not move but can shoot

sharedRules.name: Ambush Order
sharedRules.description: This **unit**/**model** does not **move** or **shoot** but instead if an **enemy model** moves withing range this **unit**/**model** can shoot them in your opponents **activation** or if this unit is being shot and this has not shot yet you can replace this with the **Down Order**
